status: User approved these 5 exact compiler diagnostics on 2026-10-06. Normal flags and warnings remain unchanged.
root_cause: GCC 13 models values outside the declared enum dispatch domain, producing uninitialized-result warnings after exhaustive switches. Unchanged enum declarations/macros and dispatch branches reproduce all five warnings.
source_invariants: SIMD 128/256 load-transform nodes store their typed TransformKind constructor arguments. Their defining macros declare 12 and 11 modes respectively; the selectors initialize opcode for each mode.

AssertCondition declares ten conditions. Every branch initializes comparison kind; swap starts false and negate is set only for not-equal. Both production callers initialize negate_result=false before invoking the helper.

Float64Ieee754Unary stores the typed Ieee754Function constructor parameter. The identical IEEE_754_UNARY_LIST macro defines all 19 function enum values and all 19 dispatch cases, assigning a FloatUnaryOp kind.
ShiftKind contains Normal and ShiftOutZeros. Both cached Word32/Word64 machine operators explicitly initialize one of these values; the graph builder handles both.
coverage: All 23 SIMD load modes, all 19 unary modes and both shift modes. Ten signed/unsigned comparison conditions run across every pair of seven boundary values (INT32_MIN, -65536, -1, 0, 1, 65536, INT32_MAX), verifying swap/negation and semantic comparison results. Optimized release/DEBUG controls, each normally and under Valgrind: 2,136,000 checks; zero errors and all allocations freed.
limits: Original enum declarations/macros and branch bodies are copied unchanged. Small typed node adapters and distinct ArchOpcode sentinels replace graph construction and real machine-code emission; the test does not claim end-to-end SIMD execution, IEEE math accuracy or backend compilation coverage. No invalid enum values are introduced. DEBUG controls retain optimization to reproduce warnings, not for benchmarking.
policy: Retain production warnings and normal compiler flags; exact sites only, no blanket suppression.
